Fixture water cycle

When the Sun warms a puddle, the water slowly turns into an invisible gas called water vapour.

Fixture fact: this change from liquid to gas is called evaporation.

Fixture clouds

Clouds in this fixture are made of tiny drops of water or small crystals of ice.

When the drops join together and grow heavy they fall as rain, snow, sleet or hail.
